<!-- pr-reviewer: 0051b764f29d477306a06cdc9eed30849837ef6d -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The change removes the four folders listed in #1794. The remaining text uses links to the original PRs. The new test checks that all four folders are absent. The decision record explains the scope. The PR body has the required process and changelog lines.

Local results against upstream/main dc44993fc93c3fc5128fb53b34822fc3e0970d8b:
- Trial merge: clean; this head already contains main.
- `cargo test -p xtask --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; 136 unit tests and 1 integration test.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Zola 0.23.6 site build: passed; 43 pages and 4 sections.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passed.

I restored each of the four folders from main in turn. Each restoration made the new test fail and name the restored folder. Each removal made the test pass again. All four checks had the expected fail/pass results. The worktree was clean after these checks.

Requested before merge: none.

This change does not affect posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, geometry, or UI code. No machining goldens or release snapshot images changed. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: 0051b764f29d477306a06cdc9eed30849837ef6d -->
Review tier: effort:medium model sufficient (docs removal plus an xtask pin test). No escalation. Cost: 137,889 tokens, 39 tool calls, about 59 minutes wall clock. Review was independent of the author. The review agent also filed follow-up issue #1845.
